answer.text: Rights of all investors including access to fair dealing, disclosure, and complaint resolution

explanation.text: The Logic: The Investor Charter for Research Analysts sets out investor rights, disclosure obligations, and grievance redressal mechanisms for investors availing research analyst services. The Trap: The Charter is not limited to a specific investor type or risk category — it covers the rights of investors dealing with Research Analysts generally. Note: SEBI has mandated display of the Investor Charter on registered Research Analysts' websites and offices.
